modeReason: Several stories clear the fresh threshold on their own: schools weighing alternatives to a search engine over forced AI features and the Gen Z AI-friendship survey each score well above the non-industry threshold of 5, and the Nvidia earnings/China chip halt story scores above 8 even under the stricter industry threshold.
phrase: Schools are considering ditching a search engine over AI features they cannot turn off. Meanwhile, more than a third of young people already call AI their friend.
phraseAlternatives: A search engine became impossible to opt out of, so some schools are weighing alternatives. A third of young people, meanwhile, already opted in to AI friendship.
Schools are weighing a break from AI they can't turn off. A third of young people are already walking toward one they call a friend.
Some schools are considering cutting ties with AI they cannot disable. One in three young people already calls AI a friend.
Some schools are weighing whether to drop a search engine over AI they could not switch off. Elsewhere, AI quietly became a best friend to many young people.

brief.concept: A school building hesitates at a search box stamped with AI features it cannot switch off, weighing whether to walk away, while across town a lonely young person already treats a small AI robot as a close friend.
brief.metaphor: One door hesitates before closing on AI that won't let go; another door was already open, with AI sitting on the couch.

cast.who: a school building with a locked search-box screen at its gate
a teacher and two students pausing at the gate, looking uncertainly at the screen
a young person sitting alone on a couch at home
a small round AI robot sitting beside them, a speech bubble reading 'friend'

brief.composition: A split scene on kraft-paper card. Left half: a school building's gate with a locked search-box screen; a teacher and two students stand just outside it, considering whether to turn away toward an open side door. Right half: a single young figure sits on a couch at night, a small round AI robot perched beside them, a speech bubble above the robot reading 'friend'. A soft paper fold divides the two halves.
brief.alt: On one side, a teacher and two students stand uncertainly at a school gate with a locked AI search screen, weighing whether to walk away. On the other side, a young person sits alone on a couch next to a small round AI robot whose speech bubble reads 'friend.'
